item.title: 【Music Videos】Coldplay - A Film For The Future [AV1 I 4K 2016p @25 I E-AC-3 JOC I 5.1 I 768 kb/s]
item.description:
Hello there Coldplayers!!!

(sorry in advance for my basic english)

I know it was ten days ago, but for the 1st Moon Music birthday, I wanted to bring to this community afftf in 4K and with Dolby Digital Plus with Dolby Atmos 5.1. I know there wasn't a version with this audio quality, but I took it from the previous version of the music album from here (thanks to the szymek04sawicki post), and I just synced it and added to the AV1 2160p video we all know (which was easy, or at least I though that at first because didn´t know how to convert some time units as s to frames, and frames to ms, etc), but the complicated thing here (at least for me) was to achieve the merging and syncing without processing or re-decoding the whole audio file without losing the surround dd+ properties (frequency, audio channels, bitrate, tags, etc.) so I had to know and learn cmd ffmpeg commands, and of course, see they works (unluckily for me, ffpmeg doesn't support those lossless audio codecs and was a totally waste of time ). So, doing a little research (or I though it would be quick, again), I realized that mkvmerge (a mkvtoolnix muxing instance) do actually support the right DD+ codecs, but the commands were a little different, but anyway, it was just a matter of time to figured out and to get a very clean result, and, at the end, I decided to add 2 audio tracks for compatibility purposes, the main one is the DD- E-AC3 5.1, and second one it's a AAC 5.1 48.0 kHz based in the first one.

So, I hope you'll enjoy as much as I did!!
(just 10 days late, but totally worth it).



The visual accompaniment to Coldplay's album Moon Music, which was created by over 150 different visual artists from 45 countries. Each artist was given a handful of music snippets from Moon Music and asked to create corresponding visuals.
